items: portable / home-backup power station sized by kW output and kWh capacity
why: In both chats ChatGPT treated this as picking one type of backup and sizing it, then showed single power-station cards (EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3, Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus); it mentioned transfer equipment only as a condition of a panel connection, which an electrician installs, not as something every shopper must buy. The deciding facts are kW for what runs at once, kWh for how long, and 120 V vs 120/240 V for well pumps and AC, so the page should compare stations Dealectric already lists (Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus and S5000, BLUETTI Apex 300, Growatt HELIOS 3600, ALLPOWERS R4000, the EcoFlow DELTA 3 line) and recommend one by load size.
